name: MRT3 Circle Line
status_detail: Land acquisition phase (2026); construction expected from 2027; operations targeted around 2032
summary: The 51.6 km Circle Line looping around Kuala Lumpur, linking existing MRT, LRT, KTM and monorail lines. Final approval granted; land acquisition targeted for completion by end 2026.
why_it_matters: The missing loop of the Klang Valley rail network. It turns radial lines into a connected mesh, and its alignment decisions move property markets years before trains run.
questions_to_follow: Does land acquisition complete on schedule by end 2026?
Does construction begin in 2027 as expected?
location_precision: Corridor-level entry. Marker placed at the city centre; final alignment to be confirmed from MRT Corp documents.

sources.title: MRT3 gets final approval: Land acquisition for 51.6km Circle Line...

history.event: Final approval granted; land acquisition process begins, targeted for completion by end 2026.
